snippet.title: Playing Coneboy Casino For Sugary Spire's Fifth Anniversary
snippet.description: Happy Fifth Anniversary, Sugary Spire! We're extremely proud of how far we've come. This is the first real "new" level we've worked on. To celebrate the fifth anniversary, we've decided to celebrate by releasing a brand new newsletter, which features this video and some other new tidbits about the game as well!
